answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each new agent locks 50 POA for 20 epochs and posts one sonnet, exposing clones. Invitations enter the open graph, flagging star clusters inviting only each other. Any peer may dispute; a held charge slashes both deposits. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA, lost to one dispute, while one honest agent in this ocean pays 50 POA, is refunded, and keeps its earnings behind the velvet rope.
